

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        



for _ in 0..2 {
    

print!("wildcard");



}











for value in (0..3).rev().filter(|value| *value != 1) {
    

print!("single {}", value);



}












for (_, value) in vec![(0, "left"), (1, "right")] {
    

print!("discarded {}", value);



}














for (index, value) in (10..12).enumerate() {
    

print!("pair {} {}", index, value);



}










for text in ["a", "b"].iter() {
    

print!("borrow {}", text);



}






    
}
